description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerService class in the OrangeHRM Performance module, providing methods to access and modify performance tracker data, including validation for edit permissions.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerService
classes.description: Service class for managing performance tracker entities, including retrieval, validation, and update operations.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerDao
methods.description: Lazily instantiates and returns the PerformanceTrackerDao instance used for data access operations.

methods.name: updateTracker
methods.description: Updates a performance tracker if the current user has permission; throws an exception if editing is not allowed.
